summary: This note summarizes the 2017 Stanley Cup Finals, the championship series of the NHL's 2016-17 season and the culmination of the 2017 Stanley Cup playoffs. The defending champion Pittsburgh Penguins beat the Western Conference champion Nashville Predators four games to two, and captain Sidney Crosby won the Conn Smythe Trophy for the second straight year. The note is a short, partly duplicated clipping with no detail beyond these main results.
one_line: The 2017 Stanley Cup Finals, in which the defending champion Pittsburgh Penguins beat the Nashville Predators four games to two.
key_facts: The 2017 Stanley Cup Finals was the championship series of the National Hockey League's (NHL) 2016 -- 17 season.
The 2017 Stanley Cup Finals was the culmination of the 2017 Stanley Cup playoffs.
The Pittsburgh Penguins were the Eastern Conference champion and the defending Stanley Cup champion.
The Nashville Predators were the Western Conference champion.
The Pittsburgh Penguins defeated the Nashville Predators four games to two in the 2017 Stanley Cup Finals.
Sidney Crosby was the captain of the Pittsburgh Penguins.
Sidney Crosby was awarded the Conn Smythe Trophy as the most valuable player of the playoffs for the second consecutive year.
The Penguins won the Stanley Cup in their opponent's rink, just as they had done in the previous four times.
